office_does: The assessor values all taxable property in the county under state law and calculates the levies set by taxing districts and voters; the office does not set tax amounts.
race_blurb: Assessor Dan Lindgren, in office since 2015 and now running as a Republican after earlier terms as a Democrat, faces Josh Nuxoll, an independent and senior appraiser in Lindgren's office. Lindgren led the primary about 55% to 45%.

candidates.summary: Grays Harbor County Assessor since 2015 and an appraiser in the office since 2007, running on modernized records and mapping systems, fair assessments and state-level assessor leadership.
highlights: Brought in the Taxsifter records site, an upgraded mass-appraisal system and the MapGeo mapping platform [S1][S2]
Says he does not support unnecessary tax increases [S1]
Has worked against property-tax-increase bills on the state assessors' legislative committee [S2]
Changed party preference from Democratic to Republican for 2026 and says the office remains nonpartisan [S2]

experience.basis: Assessor since 2015, in the office since 2007, re-elected in 2022, and on the WACO executive board; runs on his record.

taxes.basis: States he does not support unnecessary tax increases, and his release says he fought bills that would increase property taxes; the office itself does not set taxes.

candidates.summary: Senior appraiser in the Grays Harbor County Assessor's Office and former county custodian and California wildland firefighter, running as an independent on fair, equitable assessments and customer service.
highlights: Says the assessor's most important role is to assess all properties fairly and equitably [S1]
Says core office duties have been neglected in recent years, causing unfair tax burdens [S2]
Promises to be first in and last out of the office each day [S1]
Four years as an appraiser in the office; no elected experience [S1]

experience.basis: Staff appraiser with no elected experience who argues the office needs new leadership to restore public trust; has four years of inside experience.
